cohort: 266 mother-infant pairs from the placebo group of a randomized placebo-controlled trial of prebiotics and probiotics as preventive against allergic disease in infants with high allergy risk
finding: Infants born by C-section and having a high hereditary risk for allergies might have a lower risk to manifest IgE-associated eczema at 2 years, but not 5 years of age, when fed breast milk with FUT2-dependent milk oligosaccharides.
mod_finding: The presumed lower incidence of IgE-associated eczema at 2 years of age associated with FUT2-dependent oligosaccharides was observed only in C-section-born infants.
